name: @dvyio/prettier-plugin-collapse-markdown-tables
description: Prettier plugin that collapses Markdown table padding.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm run knip && npm run test:coverage:built && npm run format:dogfood:check:built
scripts.check:prettier-latest: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run test:coverage:built && npm run format:dogfood:check:built
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:stress && npm run test:mutation && npm run pack:check
scripts.format:dogfood:check: npm run build && npm run format:dogfood:check:built
scripts.format:dogfood:check:built: prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md tests/dogfood/markdown-tables.md --plugin ./dist/index.js --markdown-table-style spaced --ignore-path .prettierignore.dogfood --log-level warn
scripts.format:dogfood:fix: npm run build && prettier --write README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md tests/dogfood/markdown-tables.md --plugin ./dist/index.js --markdown-table-style spaced --ignore-path .prettierignore.dogfood --log-level warn
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:coverage:built
scripts.test:stress: NORMALIZE_MARKDOWN_TABLES_STRESS=1 vitest run tests/normalizeMarkdownTables.test.ts tests/prettierPlugin.test.ts -t "stays fast|rendering stays fast|scanning stays fast|quickly|list context stays fast|smoke-test limit|retained heap"
